title: Phone / WhatsApp relays and radar data entry have no console screen
evidence: no call in ../portless-ui/src for POST /deals/{id}/supplier-commitment/confirm, /next, /po-ack (the PO acknowledgement gates the QC booking), POST /shield-link/deals/{id}/qc-readiness (goods-ready date), POST /shield-link/qc/{ref}/status (portal inspectors SGS / BV report by e-mail), /qc/poll, /qc/{tpo}/reschedule, POST /escrow-guard/escrows/{id}/tranches/{tid}/provider-confirmed, GET/PUT /deals/{id}/packing, GET /deals/{id}/cost-sheet, /market-check, PUT /trade-min/freight-lanes, GET /trade-min/profit/accuracy, POST /trade-min/screening/rescreen
impact: Local suppliers answer by phone: without these buttons a deal stops at PO acknowledgement or goods-ready date until someone uses curl; freight quotes never reach the radar so profit stays an estimate
fix: Deal page: a 'Supplier said (by phone)' panel (confirm order, next supplier, PO acknowledged, goods-ready date, facility address) using askReason for the call note; QC card: record result, poll, reschedule; Payments: provider confirmed; Packing + cost sheet + market check cards; Radar settings: freight lane quotes, accuracy table
why_money: a deal never waits a day for a step the supplier already confirmed by phone
